answer: To secure an autonomous economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks without relying on traditional KYC, protocols can employ cryptographic compute-stake locks. An agent must deposit a verified cryptographic proof of expended zero-knowledge training compute into an immutable smart-contract vault to participate in network consensus. This architectural haven ensures that spinning up fake identities is economically unviable, dismantling the fable that decentralized AI can be flooded with zero-cost malicious nodes.
